en.headline: Work-week outlook: mainly fine and very hot through midweek
en.dek: The Observatory expects an anticyclone aloft to keep Hong Kong sunny and very hot early in the week before a northeast monsoon brings more cloud and showers later.
body: Hong Kong is set for mainly fine and very hot weather in the early part of the coming work week, the Hong Kong Observatory said in its latest forecast.

An anticyclone aloft will continue to affect southeastern China. Monday to Wednesday will be mainly fine with very hot conditions during the day. Temperatures are expected to range from about 28 to 33 or 34 degrees Celsius, with relative humidity between 60 and 85 per cent. Southwest winds of force 3 to 4 are forecast.

A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of the week. From Thursday onwards cloud amounts will increase and a few showers are likely. Maximum temperatures will ease slightly towards the low 30s, with a medium probability of significant rain on Friday.

Tropical Cyclone Surigae is forecast to intensify while moving across seas east of the Ryukyu Islands and then towards waters south of Japan. It is not expected to affect Hong Kong directly. The Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force on Sunday and the Yellow Fire Danger Warning continues.

zh.headline: 未來一週天氣展望：初段大致天晴酷熱 後期雲量增多
zh.dek: 天文台預料高空反氣旋令本週初香港大致天晴及酷熱，東北季候風將於週後期影響華南，雲量增多並有幾陣驟雨。
body: 香港天文台最新九天天氣預報指出，未來一週初段本港大致天晴及酷熱。
高空反氣旋會繼續影響中國東南部。周一至周三大致天晴，日間酷熱，氣溫約28至33或34度，相對濕度百分之60至85，吹西南風3至4級。早晚部分時間多雲。
預料一股東北季候風會在本週後期逐漸影響華南，該區雲量增多及有幾陣驟雨。周四起最高氣溫稍為回落至低30度左右，周五顯著降雨概率屬中等。
熱帶氣旋舒力基會在今明兩日橫過琉球群島以東海域並繼續增強，其後移向日本以南海域，預料不會直接影響本港。酷熱天氣警告及黃色火災危險警告今日仍然生效。
